content.thinking:
My brute-force probe logic is buggy: I include L = want_dist[s] in the range (limit = min(want_dist[s], 6) and range(limit+1) includes L = want_dist[s]), which then finds a hit at exactly the reported distance and complains. I should only check L < want_dist[s].

Let me fix: limit = want_dist[s] - 1 if want_dist[s] is not None else 6; and range(limit+1) → L from 0 to limit.

Wait: if want_dist[s] = 0 (accepting), then limit = -1 → range(0) → no checks ✓.

Let me fix that.

                  "        limit = 6 if want_dist[s] is None else want_dist[s] - 1")
